ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..
   D. Use Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on Etiquette of Eating has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara Types of Najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Say Twahara Types of Najasaat has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara Types of Najasaat.
   C. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Twahara Types of Najasaat to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on brushing teeth has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on brushing teeth.
   D. Use Hadith on brushing teeth to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels Atid,? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Angels Atid, has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels Atid, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Belief in Angels Atid, to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels Atid,.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Fitness? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Fitness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on Fitness has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Fitness.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

9. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.
   D. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Conditions for Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Conditions for Swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conditions for Swalah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Conditions for Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Conditions for Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Attributes of Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of Allah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Attributes of Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Attributes of Allah has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Dua 02 6.0 Muamalat 6.1 Obligation of parents to children 03 6.2 Obligation of c and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Dua Dua for Leaving and Entering the House and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Obligation of parents to children 03 6.2 Obligation of children to parents 02 6. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Obligations of Parents to Children and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
